input: Submit expense reports from last quarter

gold.taskDescription: The user needs to compile and submit expense reports covering the previous quarter's business expenses.

questions.title: Which quarter and fiscal year are we covering?
questions.description: Identify the exact quarter (e.g., Q1 2025, Q4 2024) the expense reports belong to.

questions.title: What system or platform do you submit reports through?
questions.description: Identify the tool or platform used for submission, such as Concur, Expensify, SAP, or an internal portal.

questions.title: Have you already collected all receipts and records?
questions.description: Determine whether the underlying documentation is ready or still needs to be gathered.

questions.title: What is the hard deadline for this submission?
questions.description: Establish the due date to prioritize and schedule the work appropriately.

questions.title: How many separate expense reports need to be submitted?
questions.description: Understand the volume of reports involved, whether it is one report or multiple across categories or trips.

questions.title: Who reviews or approves reports before final submission?
questions.description: Identify whether a manager, finance team, or another stakeholder must approve the reports first.

questions.title: Are there specific expense categories causing uncertainty or confusion?
questions.description: Pinpoint any expense types the user is unsure how to categorize or document correctly.
